behavior: Show expected, approved, and observed economics in separate totals. Filter by site, process, technology, and date.
acceptance_check: A draft case does not enter the observed savings total.

behavior: Show initiative, owner, stage, missing data, next action, demand, candidate options, and expected outcome.
acceptance_check: Open a case at its last saved stage.

behavior: Show site, process, asset count, configuration, release, stage, uptime, intervention rate, and expected versus observed result.
v2_mode: Local view with marked sample data
acceptance_check: A planned robot is separate from a robot in a site pilot or in service.

behavior: Create a case for a site and process. Record the business need, scope, owner, and decision target.
acceptance_check: The tote PoC is a specific case. Other cases use the same workflow.

behavior: Show current stage, next action, missing items, owner, and change history. Permit draft work at later stages.
acceptance_check: Draft deployment planning does not mean deployment approval.

behavior: Add source files, source links, values, units, dates, versions, and data status. Show required data for the selected process.
acceptance_check: Unknown differs from zero and from sample data.

behavior: Import validated process and scenario CSV/JSON. Preview changes before import. Export an editable case.
acceptance_check: An invalid import leaves the current case intact.

behavior: Attach engineering models, CAD, MTM, SOPs, images, and video references. Map critical values by hand.
acceptance_check: The app states that CAD parsing and video interpretation are not connected.

behavior: Compare observed, time-study, and engineering-model demand, hours, staffing, and throughput.
acceptance_check: A large difference creates a visible question. It is not silently overwritten.

behavior: Create tasks, work elements, and actions. Set sequence, branches, repeat counts, and parallel work. Keep a simple entry view.
acceptance_check: A change to an action changes the next evaluation or marks old results out of date.

behavior: Record actor, verb, object, source/target, tool, conditions, timing, success, failure, and recovery.
acceptance_check: An action without a known duration remains unknown.

behavior: Show task time, shift coverage, observed output, minimum staff, exceptions, and current cost.
acceptance_check: The baseline uses the same calendar and output definition as each option.

behavior: Show an annotated 2D plan, routes, distances, workstations, handoffs, buffers, and charge locations.
v2_mode: Manual plan with marked sample view
acceptance_check: The view does not claim to generate a warehouse from CAD.

behavior: Link required skills to measured limits and test conditions. Add capability needs such as payload, reach, grip, navigation, and sensing.
acceptance_check: Each hard requirement has a unit or an explicit test condition.

behavior: Store humanoids, AMRs/AGVs, arms, fixed automation, and assist tools in one library. Permit new technology types.
acceptance_check: The case can compare different technology classes.

behavior: Version the robot, tool, sensors, software, and interface as one option. Record compatibility and supplier support.
acceptance_check: Changing a gripper creates a different evaluated configuration.

behavior: Store limits, conditions, source, validity, and test method. Keep supplier claims separate from measured site results.
acceptance_check: A supplier speed claim does not become a proven site cycle time.

behavior: Record quote date, validity, currency, purchase/lease/RaaS terms, service cover, and one-time charges.
acceptance_check: An expired or missing quote stays visible in the result.

behavior: Show supported, blocked, unknown, or not assessed for each action/configuration pair. Explain each result.
acceptance_check: One failed hard requirement cannot be offset by a high score elsewhere.

behavior: Select a valid bundle of actions for each actor. Retain human work and recovery. Show time coverage separately from action count.
acceptance_check: Five of twelve actions does not automatically remove five twelfths of the labour.

behavior: Check preconditions, task continuity, shared tools, load control, reach, safety constraints, and handoffs.
acceptance_check: A robot cannot receive a carry action without a valid pickup and placement method.

behavior: Include current work, manual process improvement, assisted work, hybrid teams, and automation where feasible.
acceptance_check: The engine can recommend the current method or ask for more data.

behavior: Assign actions to roles and configurations. Add handoffs, buffers, parallel work, recovery, and changed layout needs.
acceptance_check: The proposed process has its own version and differs visibly from the baseline.

behavior: Select an assumption, supplier result, benchmark, simulation result, or field trial for each task/configuration/condition set.
v2_mode: Working record; external runs not connected
acceptance_check: Every cycle time and success rate links to its source.

behavior: List missing tests. Prepare a benchmark or simulation brief with input/output fields, conditions, and acceptance criteria.
v2_mode: Working brief; external job shown as not connected
acceptance_check: A simulated sample run has a demo label. It does not close a real test gap.

behavior: Compare bounded fleet sizes, technology combinations, task bundles, shift patterns, and retained staff.
acceptance_check: Show the search bounds, tested options, rejected options, and reasons.

behavior: Use active time, travel, charge, maintenance, failures, recovery, queues, handoffs, and peak demand. State model limits.
v2_mode: Screening calculation; complex event simulation deferred
acceptance_check: Do not count charging twice inside both availability and a second charge factor.

behavior: Vary demand, task time, success, interventions, availability, cost, and benefit capture. Include peak and failure cases.
acceptance_check: Show which requirement fails first and the value at that point.

behavior: Show completed units, bottleneck, human workload, robot load, queue/wait limits, quality, and unserved demand.
acceptance_check: A failure to meet throughput remains visible even if savings look positive.

behavior: Separate time removed, residual work, achievable staffing change, avoided hires, redeployed capacity, and cash benefit.
acceptance_check: A fractional time gain does not create an automatic staff reduction.

behavior: Include all selected capital, operating, integration, site, support, compute, energy, training, recovery, and ramp-up costs.
acceptance_check: Purchase cash flow does not count depreciation as a second cash cost.

behavior: Compare purchase, lease, and RaaS. Define inclusions to prevent duplicate support, maintenance, or software charges.
acceptance_check: Costs are visible by year and by cost owner.

behavior: Show net annual cash saving, first-year cash flow, payback, life-cycle cost, cost per completed unit, and optional discounted value.
acceptance_check: A negative case shows no positive payback claim.

behavior: Limit the study to the agreed horizon. Show customer, site, and DP World retained benefit where required.
acceptance_check: A cost-plus benefit transferred to a customer is not counted as DP World cash saving.

behavior: Compare feasible options on throughput, quality, human work, cost, readiness, and evidence gaps. Explain trade-offs.
acceptance_check: There is no unexplained single score that can hide a failed constraint.

behavior: Show technical status, evidence basis, economic stress results, and deployment readiness separately.
acceptance_check: No percentage is labelled probability without a defined and supported method.

behavior: State the site/process, tasks assigned, people and equipment, demand met, cost, savings, payback, assumptions, gaps, and next action.
acceptance_check: The report names the exact process and configuration versions.

behavior: Record continue, change, test, defer, or stop with an owner and reason. Preserve the reviewed result.
v2_mode: Working local record; authority is demonstrative
acceptance_check: Changing a critical input marks the former decision out of date.

behavior: Create a plan from the selected scenario. Include tasks, roles, interfaces, schedule, site changes, cost, and success measures.
acceptance_check: The selected robot count and process version carry into the plan.

behavior: Select OEM configuration/commissioning, policy/model adaptation, or a combined route. Record who must supply each element.
acceptance_check: Training is required only when the selected solution needs it.

behavior: List datasets, labels, simulation assets, target hardware, model/policy version, compute, training runs, tests, and failures.
v2_mode: Planning records and marked demo runs
acceptance_check: No screen states that the app trained a real robot model.

behavior: Link the supported hardware, configuration, software/model, test evidence, operating limits, and rollback version.
v2_mode: Working local record; no hardware connection
acceptance_check: A release cannot imply support for unverified hardware.

behavior: Track work-area preparation, interfaces, charge plan, operator training, fallback, support, and required site tests.
v2_mode: Working local checklist and test log
acceptance_check: A demo checklist is separate from a real site safety acceptance.

behavior: Set supervised trial conditions, stop rules, success measures, duration, sample needs, and accountable decisions.
acceptance_check: A passed training run does not authorize a site pilot.

behavior: Show the future sequence to package, load, check, and start the approved release on supported hardware.
acceptance_check: Use Plan transfer or View demo. Do not offer a false live deployment button.

behavior: Track robots, site, process, counts, configuration, release, status, support owner, and service history.
acceptance_check: Planned, in pilot, in service, paused, and retired assets remain distinct.

behavior: Enter or import throughput, good units, failures, interventions, active/charge/down time, human hours, and cost.
v2_mode: Manual/CSV local input; live feed deferred
acceptance_check: Observed records have time windows, denominators, and source labels.

behavior: Compare the pilot with the approved baseline and scenario. Explain deviations and update the business case.
acceptance_check: A change in demand is shown before attributing the difference to the robot.

behavior: Open an issue, revise a process/configuration, plan a new test, roll back, or prepare another site with a local gap check.
acceptance_check: A result from one site does not automatically prove the same result at another site.

behavior: Save local cases, version critical inputs, export/import complete editable records, and keep source/result links.
acceptance_check: Reload and export/import preserve the case. Recalculation uses current inputs.

behavior: Use short active sentences, stable terms, units beside fields, clear errors, keyboard access, and progressive detail.
acceptance_check: A user can follow the next action without knowing the robotics stack.

behavior: Define replaceable services for CAD, process simulation, physics, training, vendor deployment, WMS, and telemetry.
acceptance_check: An unavailable adapter returns Not connected, not a synthetic success.
